description: This file defines the 'ClientCollateralManagementReadPlatformService' interface, which provides methods for retrieving client collateral management data, such as collateral details and loan collateral templates, within the collateral management module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: ClientCollateralManagementReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for reading client collateral data, including obtaining collateral details and loan templates.

methods.name: getClientCollateralManagementData
methods.description: Retrieves collateral management data for a specific collateral ID.

methods.name: getClientCollaterals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of collaterals associated with a specific client and product.

methods.name: getLoanCollateralTemplate
methods.description: Fetches loan collateral template data for a specific client.
